title: Midnight Psychic's "Mixtape" is a journey through heartache and memories
htmlContent: Midnight Psychic's latest single, "Mixtape," takes listeners on an emotional journey into the past. The song creates a feeling of sadness and longing, reflecting a desire for things that can never be brought back. It feels more like a personal diary entry, capturing the pain of remembering in a way that only songs can. The band first put together a version that didn't feel right, so they decided to try something new and adventurous. This choice captures the song's spirit, mixing uncomfortable feelings with something that draws you in. The music has a haunting quality, starting off with a sense of emptiness, almost like wandering through the memories we leave behind. https://open.spotify.com/track/46jT3TWDmdNJkhH265BXPL?si=5PMXAV1vQPegBAQ8J-c5jA The song has a strong feeling of yearning and chaos. It's as if Midnight Psychic is reaching for something lost, something beautiful but just out of reach. The raw quality of the sound reflects the frustration of trying to hold onto moments that seem to slip away. Follow on: Instagram
